verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Audiences feature for building audiences on warehouse sources and activating them downstream, so the core axis exists. The evidence does not show it is a visual, no-SQL builder over traits and behavior, and it says nothing about size estimates. The adjacent Profiles feature relies on YAML, which is a developer workflow rather than a marketer one. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual/no-SQL audience builder, trait and behavioral condition support, estimated audience size preview before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating
